text: Ụmụnna m, anyị zukọrọ ebe a maka okwu dị mkpa.
gloss: My kinsmen, we have gathered here for an important matter.

text: N'abalị ahụ, obodo ahụ niile dara jụụ.
gloss: That night, the whole town fell silent.

text: Agadi nwoke ahụ nọdụrụ n'obi na-echeta oge ntorobịa ya.
gloss: The old man sat in his compound recalling his youth.

text: Ilu bụ mmanụ e ji eri okwu.
gloss: Proverbs are the palm oil with which words are eaten.

text: Umunna bụ otu ezinụlọ sitere n'otu nna nna.
gloss: Umunna is the patrilineage descended from one ancestor.

text: Egbe bere, ugo bere.
gloss: Let the kite perch, let the eagle perch.

text: Onye wetara ọjị wetara ndụ.
gloss: Whoever brings kola brings life.

text: Aka nri kwọọ aka ekpe, aka ekpe akwọọ aka nri.
gloss: The right hand washes the left, the left washes the right.

text: O doro anya na okwu a chọrọ mkparịta ụka miri emi.
gloss: Clearly this matter needs deep discussion.

text: Enweghị mgbagha na ọdịnihu mba dabere n'ụdị agụmakwụkwọ a na-enye taa.
gloss: Undoubtedly, the nation's future depends on the education given today.

text: Ọ bụrụ na anyị amụtaghị ihe n'akụkọ ihe mere eme, anyị ga-emeghachi otu ndudue ahụ.
gloss: If we don't learn from history, we will repeat the same mistakes.

text: Chinua Achebe ji ilu mee ka akụkọ ya dị ndụ.
gloss: Chinua Achebe used proverbs to make his stories come alive.

text: Mmanwụ na-anọchite anya mmụọ ndị nna nna n'ọha.
gloss: Masquerades represent ancestral spirits in the community.

text: Onye aghala nwanne ya.
gloss: Let no one abandon his kin.

text: Kitabu nilichonunua jana kimepotea.
gloss: The book that I bought yesterday has got lost.

text: Mtu aliyekuja jana ni mwalimu wetu.
gloss: The person who came yesterday is our teacher.

text: Barua iliandikwa na mkurugenzi.
gloss: The letter was written by the director.

text: Ndugu hao wawili walipendana sana.
gloss: Those two siblings loved each other very much.

text: Habari hizo zilimshangaza kila mtu.
gloss: That news surprised everyone.

text: Wakulima hulima mashamba yao mapema asubuhi.
gloss: Farmers (habitually) cultivate their fields early in the morning.

text: Hata hivyo, serikali imesema itaendelea na mpango huo.
gloss: However, the government has said it will continue with that plan.

text: Samahani, naomba unisaidie kidogo.
gloss: Excuse me, may I ask you to help me a little.

text: Haraka haraka haina baraka
gloss: Hurry hurry has no blessing.

text: Penye nia pana njia
gloss: Where there is a will there is a way.

text: Akili ni nywele kila mtu ana zake
gloss: Wisdom is like hair, everyone has their own.

text: dalili ya mvua ni mawingu
gloss: Clouds are the sign of rain.

text: umoja ni nguvu na utengano ni udhaifu
gloss: Unity is strength, division is weakness.

text: Kwa maoni yangu, elimu bure imesaidia watoto wengi kwenda shule.
gloss: In my opinion, free education has helped many children go to school.

text: Sidhani kama mpango huu utafanikiwa bila msaada wa wananchi.
gloss: I don't think this plan will succeed without citizens' support.

text: Ninakubaliana nawe kwa kiasi fulani, lakini si kabisa.
gloss: I agree with you to some extent, but not completely.

text: Inaonekana kwamba bei za vyakula zitaendelea kupanda mwaka huu.
gloss: It seems that food prices will keep rising this year.

text: Nina wasiwasi kuhusu athari za mabadiliko ya tabianchi kwa wakulima.
gloss: I am worried about the effects of climate change on farmers.

text: Ni muhimu kusikiliza pande zote mbili kabla ya kuamua.
gloss: It is important to listen to both sides before deciding.

text: Nadhani vijana wanapaswa kupewa nafasi zaidi katika uongozi.
gloss: I think young people should be given more opportunities in leadership.

text: Si kweli kwamba teknolojia inaharibu utamaduni wetu.
gloss: It is not true that technology destroys our culture.

text: Hoja yako ina mantiki, ila inahitaji ushahidi zaidi.
gloss: Your argument makes sense, but it needs more evidence.

text: Ningependa kuongeza jambo moja kwenye mjadala huu.
gloss: I would like to add one point to this discussion.

text: Mwanafunzi aliyeshinda tuzo ni dada yangu.
gloss: The student who won the prize is my sister.

text: Nyumba tuliyoijenga mwaka jana imeuzwa.
gloss: The house we built last year has been sold.

text: Watu wanaoishi mjini hulipa kodi kubwa.
gloss: People who live in town pay high rent.

text: Gari ambalo lilipata ajali limeondolewa barabarani.
gloss: The car that had an accident has been removed from the road.

text: Vitabu ambavyo umeniazima ni vya kuvutia sana.
gloss: The books you lent me are very interesting.

text: Mahali tulipokutana kwa mara ya kwanza pamebadilika sana.
gloss: The place where we first met has changed a lot.

text: Siku aliyozaliwa mvua ilinyesha sana.
gloss: On the day he was born it rained heavily.

text: Mti uliokatwa jana ulikuwa wa zamani sana.
gloss: The tree that was cut down yesterday was very old.

text: Habari tunazozisikia redioni si za kweli zote.
gloss: Not all the news we hear on the radio is true.

text: Mwalimu anayefundisha hisabati ni mkali kidogo.
gloss: The teacher who teaches maths is a bit strict.

text: Ukija mapema, tutaondoka pamoja.
gloss: If you come early, we will leave together.

text: Kama ningekuwa na pesa, ningenunua shamba.
gloss: If I had money, I would buy a farm.

text: Ningalijua kwamba unaumwa, ningalikutembelea.
gloss: Had I known you were ill, I would have visited you.

text: Mvua ikinyesha leo, mkutano utaahirishwa.
gloss: If it rains today, the meeting will be postponed.

text: Usipokula vizuri, utakuwa dhaifu.
gloss: If you don't eat well, you will become weak.

text: Wakishinda mchezo huu, wataingia fainali.
gloss: If they win this match, they will reach the final.

text: Kama asingechelewa, angepata basi.
gloss: If he hadn't been late, he would have caught the bus.

text: Ukimwona Juma, mwambie anipigie simu.
gloss: If you see Juma, tell him to call me.

text: Mama aliwapikia wageni wali na samaki.
gloss: Mother cooked rice and fish for the guests.

text: Nitakuandikia barua wiki ijayo.
gloss: I will write you a letter next week.

text: Mwalimu aliwasomea wanafunzi hadithi.
gloss: The teacher read a story to the students.

text: Daktari alimpimia mgonjwa joto.
gloss: The doctor took the patient's temperature.

text: Mlango ulifunguliwa na mlinzi.
gloss: The door was opened by the guard.

text: Wezi walikamatwa na polisi usiku.
gloss: The thieves were arrested by the police at night.

text: Sheria mpya imepitishwa na bunge.
gloss: A new law has been passed by parliament.

text: Watoto walipigana uwanjani.
gloss: The children fought each other in the field.

text: Tulisaidiana kumaliza kazi hiyo.
gloss: We helped each other finish that work.

text: Marafiki hao huandikiana barua kila mwezi.
gloss: Those friends write to each other every month.

text: Mwalimu aliwasimamisha wanafunzi wote.
gloss: The teacher made all the students stand up.

text: Habari hiyo ilimhuzunisha sana.
gloss: That news saddened him greatly.

text: Tunapaswa kuwafundisha watoto kusoma mapema.
gloss: We should teach children to read early.

text: Kikombe kimevunjika.
gloss: The cup has broken.

text: Maandishi haya hayasomeki.
gloss: This writing is illegible.

text: Tatizo hili linatatulika.
gloss: This problem is solvable.

text: Aliufungua mlango kisha akaufunga tena.
gloss: He opened the door and then closed it again.

text: Nguo zilizofuliwa zimeanikwa nje.
gloss: The washed clothes have been hung outside.

text: Nilipofika, walikuwa wameshaondoka.
gloss: When I arrived, they had already left.

text: Tutakuwa tumemaliza kazi kabla ya saa tano.
gloss: We will have finished the work before eleven o'clock.

text: Alikuwa akisoma wakati umeme ulipokatika.
gloss: He was reading when the electricity went off.

text: Bado hajafika nyumbani.
gloss: He hasn't arrived home yet.

text: Sijawahi kufika Zanzibar.
gloss: I have never been to Zanzibar.

text: Aliamka, akaoga, akaenda kazini.
gloss: He woke up, bathed and went to work.

text: Wazee hukaa chini ya mti huu jioni.
gloss: The elders usually sit under this tree in the evening.

text: Tumekuwa tukisubiri kwa saa mbili.
gloss: We have been waiting for two hours.

text: Angali anasoma chuo kikuu.
gloss: She is still studying at university.

text: Mara nilipoingia, simu ililia.
gloss: As soon as I entered, the phone rang.

text: Kwanza, tuangalie tatizo lenyewe.
gloss: First, let us look at the problem itself.

text: Zaidi ya hayo, gharama za usafiri zimepanda.
gloss: Moreover, transport costs have risen.

text: Kwa hiyo, tunahitaji mpango mpya.
gloss: Therefore, we need a new plan.

text: Kwa mfano, shule nyingi hazina maktaba.
gloss: For example, many schools have no library.

text: Kwa upande mwingine, wazazi nao wana jukumu.
gloss: On the other hand, parents also have a responsibility.

text: Hatimaye, mkutano ulimalizika kwa amani.
gloss: Finally, the meeting ended peacefully.

text: Badala yake, aliamua kubaki nyumbani.
gloss: Instead, he decided to stay at home.

text: Kwa ujumla, mradi huu umefanikiwa.
gloss: Overall, this project has succeeded.

text: Aidha, wanafunzi walipewa vitabu vipya.
gloss: In addition, the students were given new books.

text: Hata hivyo, matatizo bado yapo.
gloss: However, problems still exist.

text: Naomba radhi kwa kuchelewa.
gloss: I apologise for being late.

text: Je, ungeweza kunisaidia kubeba mzigo huu?
gloss: Could you help me carry this load?

text: Tafadhali nisubiri kidogo.
gloss: Please wait for me a little.

text: Samahani kwa kukusumbua, mzee.
gloss: Sorry to bother you, sir.

text: Ningeomba ruhusa ya kuondoka mapema leo.
gloss: I would like to ask permission to leave early today.

text: Karibu sana, jisikie uko nyumbani.
gloss: You are very welcome, make yourself at home.

text: Pole sana kwa msiba uliokupata.
gloss: I am very sorry for your loss.

text: Asante kwa ukarimu wako.
gloss: Thank you for your hospitality.

text: Shikamoo bibi. — Marahaba mjukuu wangu.
gloss: Greetings, grandmother. — Thank you, my grandchild.

text: Mheshimiwa Mwenyekiti, naomba kuchangia hoja.
gloss: Honourable Chairperson, I ask to contribute to the motion.

text: Ninaomba nafasi ya kazi iliyotangazwa gazetini.
gloss: I am applying for the job advertised in the newspaper.

text: Nina uzoefu wa miaka mitano katika uhasibu.
gloss: I have five years of experience in accounting.

text: Mkutano wa wafanyakazi utafanyika Jumatatu ijayo.
gloss: The staff meeting will take place next Monday.

text: Tafadhali tuma ripoti kabla ya Ijumaa.
gloss: Please send the report before Friday.

text: Mshahara wangu hautoshi kulipa gharama zote.
gloss: My salary is not enough to pay all the costs.

text: Kampuni imeamua kuajiri wafanyakazi wapya kumi.
gloss: The company has decided to hire ten new employees.

text: Alifukuzwa kazi kwa sababu ya uzembe.
gloss: He was dismissed for negligence.

text: Tunahitaji kujadili mkataba kabla ya kusaini.
gloss: We need to discuss the contract before signing.

text: Nimekuwa na homa tangu jana usiku.
gloss: I have had a fever since last night.

text: Daktari aliniandikia dawa za kutumia kwa siku tano.
gloss: The doctor prescribed medicine for five days.

text: Ni vizuri kunywa maji mengi kila siku.
gloss: It is good to drink a lot of water every day.

text: Ugonjwa wa malaria huenezwa na mbu.
gloss: Malaria is spread by mosquitoes.

text: Alilazwa hospitalini kwa wiki mbili.
gloss: He was admitted to hospital for two weeks.

text: Mazoezi husaidia kupunguza msongo wa mawazo.
gloss: Exercise helps reduce stress.

text: Watoto wote wanapaswa kupata chanjo.
gloss: All children should be vaccinated.

text: Ukataji wa miti umesababisha ukame katika eneo hili.
gloss: Tree cutting has caused drought in this area.

text: Tunapaswa kupunguza matumizi ya mifuko ya plastiki.
gloss: We should reduce the use of plastic bags.

text: Mafuriko yameharibu mashamba mengi mwaka huu.
gloss: Floods have destroyed many farms this year.

text: Wanyama pori wanalindwa katika hifadhi za taifa.
gloss: Wild animals are protected in national parks.

text: Maji safi yanazidi kuwa adimu vijijini.
gloss: Clean water is becoming increasingly scarce in villages.

text: Takataka zinapaswa kutupwa mahali maalum.
gloss: Rubbish should be thrown in a designated place.

text: Gazeti hili linaripoti habari za kitaifa na kimataifa.
gloss: This newspaper reports national and international news.

text: Mitandao ya kijamii imebadilisha jinsi tunavyowasiliana.
gloss: Social media has changed how we communicate.

text: Si kila habari unayoisoma mtandaoni ni ya kweli.
gloss: Not every piece of news you read online is true.

text: Kipindi hicho kinarushwa kila Jumamosi jioni.
gloss: That programme is broadcast every Saturday evening.

text: Mwandishi wa habari alimhoji waziri.
gloss: The journalist interviewed the minister.

text: Safari kutoka Dar es Salaam hadi Arusha huchukua saa kumi.
gloss: The trip from Dar es Salaam to Arusha takes ten hours.

text: Nilipoteza mzigo wangu uwanja wa ndege.
gloss: I lost my luggage at the airport.

text: Tulikata tiketi mapema ili tusikose nafasi.
gloss: We bought tickets early so as not to miss a seat.

text: Hoteli tuliyofikia ilikuwa safi na tulivu.
gloss: The hotel we stayed at was clean and quiet.

text: Basi liliharibika njiani, tukachelewa.
gloss: The bus broke down on the way, so we were late.

text: Wanafunzi wanajiandaa kwa mitihani ya taifa.
gloss: Students are preparing for the national exams.

text: Alifaulu mtihani kwa alama za juu.
gloss: She passed the exam with high marks.

text: Chuo kikuu kinatoa ufadhili kwa wanafunzi maskini.
gloss: The university offers scholarships to poor students.

text: Lugha ya kufundishia ni suala lenye utata.
gloss: The language of instruction is a controversial issue.

text: Wazazi wanapaswa kufuatilia maendeleo ya watoto wao.
gloss: Parents should follow their children's progress.

text: Siku moja, mvuvi mmoja alikwenda baharini peke yake.
gloss: One day, a fisherman went to sea alone.

text: Ghafla, upepo mkali ulianza kuvuma.
gloss: Suddenly, a strong wind began to blow.

text: Alijaribu kurudi pwani lakini mawimbi yalikuwa makubwa.
gloss: He tried to return to shore but the waves were big.

text: Baada ya saa nyingi, aliona mwanga kwa mbali.
gloss: After many hours, he saw a light in the distance.

text: Mwishowe, wavuvi wengine walimwokoa.
gloss: In the end, other fishermen rescued him.

text: Tangu siku hiyo, hakwenda baharini peke yake tena.
gloss: From that day on, he never went to sea alone again.

text: Wageni hukaribishwa kwa chai na vitafunio.
gloss: Guests are welcomed with tea and snacks.

text: Katika harusi za pwani, taarab huimbwa usiku kucha.
gloss: At coastal weddings, taarab is sung all night.

text: Ni adabu kula kwa mkono wa kulia.
gloss: It is polite to eat with the right hand.

text: Wakati wa Ramadhani, watu wengi hufunga mchana.
gloss: During Ramadan, many people fast in the daytime.

text: Kanga huwa na maandishi ya methali au ujumbe.
gloss: A kanga usually carries a proverb or message.
